data.one_liner: Annotations for Theme Tailor code generator, no runtime logic.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotation classes used by Theme Tailor to generate theme extension code at compile time. It has no runtime behavior and depends on Theme Tailor.
use_when: When using Theme Tailor to generate theme extensions
When you want type‑safe, compile‑time theme getters
avoid_when: When you are not using Theme Tailor or need runtime annotations
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run `flutter pub run build_runner build`
